original_target.title: SIC measurements in every finite dimension
original_target.outcome: Claim: affirmative existence in every dimension

scope_comparison: The paper combines its unconditional unitary-conjugate theorem with RW26 Theorem7 and AFK25 Theorem1.46 to assert M^2 complex equiangular lines in C^M for every M>=4. The known d2/3 constructions complete the target. Maximal complex equiangular families are SICs; no covariance assumption or unresolved Stark hypothesis remains in this announced conclusion.

primary_sources.locator: §9.2, Proposition7 and its concluding SIC paragraph, printedp17
